integrity: All stated limits are supplied with a full analytic proof; standalone finite-time numerical checks support but do not certify the limits.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible column-Markov switching, fixed strictly positive rates, known generator, flat power-law uniform competition p>1, subcapacity positive initial state; exact infinite-time observables only; no finite-time noise robustness.
title: Recovering hidden proliferation rates from algebraic phenotype relaxation
